name: Redrix SEO
author: redrix

sections.description:
Redrix SEO researches the keywords your customers search for, writes articles in your brand’s voice and publishes them on your site every day. This plugin is the bridge between your WordPress site and Redrix SEO:

  • connects with a single key, no application password needed;
  • publishes or schedules posts on the calendar date, with the cover set as the featured image;
  • fills in the SEO title, meta description and focus keyword in Yoast SEO or Rank Math;
  • every request from Redrix SEO is signed (HMAC-SHA256) and can only be used once;
  • article HTML goes through the WordPress content filter.

External services

This plugin connects to Redrix SEO (https://redrixseo.com), the service that writes and sends the articles. Without a Redrix SEO account the plugin does nothing.

  • When you click Connect (Settings > Redrix SEO), the plugin sends to https://app.redrixseo.com/api/wordpress-plugin/pair: the connection key you entered, a secret generated on this site, the site and REST API URLs, the site name, the name of the user who connected, and the WordPress and plugin versions. This only happens when an administrator clicks Connect.
  • Once connected, Redrix SEO calls this site’s API (routes redrix-seo/v1/status and redrix-seo/v1/posts) to publish or schedule the articles approved in the Redrix SEO dashboard. The plugin does not send any data about visitors or other users.

Terms of Service: https://redrixseo.com/termos
Privacy Policy: https://redrixseo.com/privacidade
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, upload the .zip file and activate it.
  2. In the Redrix SEO dashboard, open Settings > Integrations > WordPress plugin and click Generate key.
  3. In WordPress, open Settings > Redrix SEO, paste the key and click Connect.
